notes: Merged 2026-07-23: live catalog-verified data unioned with a crawler+verifier reap of sixth.ucsd.edu (GERequirements.pdf updated June 2026, labeled 2026-27; AP/IB charts and overlaps list). Fixes vs prior live: Experiential Learning and DEI course lists were empty (now enumerated; DEI list is the university-wide set shared with Eighth College data); AHI needed 0->1; added JTCCER bucket; CAT bucket gains CAT 2CE/3CE (Community-Engaged Honors path — substitution for CAT 2/3 is a strong inference, not verbatim) and CAT 125 bucket gains 125R/125GS. ELWR folded into the CAT note (prereq to CAT 1). Degree completion (180 units, 60 UD, 2.0 GPA, senior residency) intentionally not modeled as buckets. Transfers: exempt from CAT 1-3 and JTCCER; full IGETC or UC Reciprocity satisfies all Sixth lower-division GEs; ELR and CAT 125/125R still required at UCSD. 2026-07-24: the AP/IB awards in the bucket notes are now also encoded machine-readably as bucket.examCredits ({exam: ap-ib-credit.js id, minScore, courses|units}) so the Degree Audit can credit exams that carry no UCSD course exemption (e.g. AP US History); cross-checked against the catalog.ucsd.edu AP credit chart (Sixth column).

buckets.label: Culture, Art, and Technology (CAT) Writing Sequence
buckets.note: Taken in order: CAT 1 (Fall, 4u) -> CAT 2 (Winter, 6u) -> CAT 3 (Spring, 6u); each is prereq to the next; no AP/IB/transfer substitution; transfers exempt from CAT 1-3. ELWR must be satisfied before CAT 1 (AP English 3+, AP Research/Seminar 3+, IB English A HL 5+ qualify). Letter grade recommended for CAT 2/3. Community-Engaged Honors admits take CAT 2CE/3CE in Winter/Spring; that 2CE/3CE substitute for CAT 2/3 is a strong inference, not a verbatim statement. CAT 3CE also satisfies JTCCER.

buckets.label: Information Technology Fluency
buckets.note: One programming/computing course (4u) from this approved list (NANO 15 and CENG 15 are cross-listed; R-versions permitted). AP CS A 4-5 (exempts CSE 8A) or AP CS Principles 4-5 (exempts CSE 3) satisfies; IB Computer Science HL 5-7 satisfies; a 3 on AP CS = elective only. Verified June 2026 GE PDF (2026-27).

buckets.label: Social Analysis (Modes of Inquiry: Social Sciences)
buckets.note: Two social-science courses (8u) from TWO DIFFERENT departments on this list; ranges verbatim from the GE PDF (ANTH 1-4, ECON 1-3, PSYC 1-7); POLI 10-13 expanded to base+D. AP Micro/Macro Econ, US Gov (also meets AHI at 3+), Comparative Gov, Psychology at 4-5 each = 1 course; IB HL 5+ Anthro/Econ/Global Politics/Psych = 1 each. Many options double-count with DEI and/or AHI. Verified June 2026 GE PDF.

buckets.label: Narrative, Aesthetic, and Historical Reasoning (Modes of Inquiry: Humanities)
buckets.note: Two humanities courses (8u). Literature = any LT** 1-50 except LTWR, plus any Literature course taught in a non-English language; lower-division non-English-language Linguistics (except LIDS) also qualifies (not fully enumerable). AP 3-5: Art History / US History (also meets AHI) / Euro History / World History / non-English Language / Spanish Lit = 2 courses; African American Studies or Latin = 1. IB HL 5+ History/Latin/Lang A/Phil/Theatre/Visual Arts = 2. Verified June 2026 GE PDF.

buckets.label: Analytical and Scientific Methods (Modes of Inquiry: Natural Sciences)
buckets.note: Two natural-science courses (8u); ranges verbatim from the GE PDF (BILD 1-3 and 7-38; SIO 1-50; PHYS 1A/1AL-1C/1CL, 2A-2C, 4A-4E, 8-12; CHEM 6A-6C/6AH-6CH). AP Bio/Chem/Physics 1-2 (3-5) = 2 courses; Physics C Mech/E&M = 1 each; AP Environmental Science 4-5 = 1. IB HL 5+ Bio/Chem/Physics = 2. ENVR 30, PHYS 12, SIO 15/20/20R/25/30/35/40 double-count with JTCCER. Verified June 2026 GE PDF.

buckets.label: Structured Reasoning (Modes of Inquiry: Math/Logic)
buckets.note: One math or logic course (4u): PHIL 10/12 and LIGN 17 are the logic options; MATH 3C/4C, 10A-10C, 20A-20C the calculus streams. AP Calculus AB or BC 3-5 satisfies; IB Math Analysis & Approaches HL 5-7 satisfies; IB Math Applications & Interpretation and AP Precalculus earn no credit. Verified June 2026 GE PDF.

buckets.label: Exploring Data
buckets.note: One probability/statistics/statistical-methods course (4u) from this list; POLI 5/5D and 30/30D expanded to base+D; options for science and non-science majors. AP Statistics 3-5 satisfies. Verified June 2026 GE PDF.

buckets.label: Art Making
buckets.note: 8 units (typically two courses) in literature/music/theatre & dance/visual arts from this approved list; some MUS ensemble/section courses (2AK-2CK, 95C-95W) are under 4 units each, so unit count (not course count) governs. AP Studio Art (8-unit max across Drawing/2D/3D) or AP Music Theory 3-5 = 2 courses; IB HL 5+ Dance/Film/Music = 2 courses. Verified June 2026 GE PDF.

buckets.label: Experiential Learning
buckets.note: Upper-division, >=4 units, except CAT 90 (1u P/NP fall seminar tied to a summer activity of >=80 hrs over >=5 wks ending Jul 1-Oct 1). CAT 124 changes quarterly (preauthorization required); AIP 197/197EX internships >=4u; also any course on the ELR approved list (external Google Sheets), Global Seminars, study abroad >=4 wks (>=4 UD UC units), or a pre-approved proposal (due Fri of Wk 8 the quarter BEFORE; no retroactive credit). May overlap major/minor but not another Sixth GE.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Writing (CAT 125)
buckets.note: One of CAT 125 (in person), CAT 125R (online), or CAT 125GS (embedded in Sixth Global Seminars) — Public Rhetoric and Practical Communication, 4u, offered every quarter. Prereqs: completed lower-division writing sequence + upper-division standing. Required of ALL Sixth students including transfers; no AP/IB/transfer substitution. Letter grade recommended.

buckets.label: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)
buckets.note: Campuswide requirement: one approved DEI course (4u, C- or P or better); Sixth allows unrestricted double-counting with GE, major, and AHI. Course list is the university-wide DEI-approved enumeration (shared with Eighth College data); the official list is updated quarterly by the Undergraduate Council — verify current membership. The enumerated list is the Academic Senate's campuswide approved list (dei-list-of-courses.pdf, updated December 2025), identical for every college; /R and GS codes are the remote and Global Seminar versions of the same approved course.

buckets.label: American History and Institutions
buckets.note: UC systemwide requirement: one approved course (P or C- or better) OR exam — AP US History 3+, AP US Government 3+, IB History of the Americas HL 5+. Waived at degree conferral for F-1/J-1 visa holders. HIUS 100-199 = any upper-division HIUS except colloquia; R-versions of ETHN courses also qualify. Many options double-count with Sixth GEs and DEI.

buckets.label: Jane Teranes Climate Change Education Requirement (JTCCER)
buckets.note: Applies to first-years entering Fall 2024 or later (transfers exempt): one approved one-quarter course passed with C- or higher (or P). CAT 3CE satisfies it for Community-Engaged Honors participants. List = university-wide approved set (shared with Eighth College data) unioned with Sixth's named GE-overlap set (ENVR 30, PHYS 12, SIO 15-40 incl. 20R, USP 2 double-count with Sixth GEs).
